Name: CHR_MODEL_PARAM_ST
Description: Per-model character settings. The row ID is the character model number (c2010 uses row 2010), for enemies and players alike. Read when the character's model is set up; a missing row uses the defaults (0).

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Marks rows left out of the Network Test build. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Model Memory Type
Fields.Description: Memory pool type the character's model is loaded into (0-7). Read by the model loader; what each type means is not established.

Fields.Name: Texture Memory Type
Fields.Description: Memory pool type the character's textures are loaded into (0-7). Read by the model loader; what each type means is not established.

Fields.Name: Camera Fade Param ID
Fields.Description: CameraFadeParam row that fades (dithers) the model out when the camera gets close. -1: use the material's setting; 0: never fades. Retail 101, 110 or 120 for most enemies.

Fields.Name: Report Threshold: Animation Memory (MB)
Fields.Description: Development report threshold for animation memory. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Exclude from Ray Tracing
Fields.Description: If set, the model isn't added to the ray-tracing scene. Unset in retail.

Fields.Name: Ray Tracing Culling Mode
Fields.Description: Culling mode used for the model in ray tracing. 0: default (same as no row). Retail 3 on 53 models, 2 on one.

Fields.Name: Ray Tracing BLAS Rebuild Type
Fields.Description: Ray tracing BLAS rebuild setting for the model. 0: default (same as no row). Retail 4 on 31 models (bosses and large enemies), 5 on 3 (e.g. Radahn, Fire Giant).
